Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the SEO Specialist position at IKEA. With my background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to IKEA's digital presence and help drive organic growth.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO for client websites, conduct keyword research, and create keyword-targeted content. I have hands-on experience with tools like SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console, and I am comfortable working in CMS environments like WordPress. My personal project, mirook.com, has allowed me to implement structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO audits, improving visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am passionate about continuous learning and staying ahead of industry shifts, especially in mobile strategy and AI search. I am eager to bring my skills to IKEA and help spread an SEO mindset across teams.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of discussing how I can contribute to IKEA's goals.

Best regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the SEO Specialist position at IKEA. As a digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for search engine optimization, I am drawn to IKEA's commitment to becoming the world's leading multichannel home furnishing retailer. I believe my skills and experience align well with the requirements of this role.

In my current position as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have been responsible for on-page SEO, keyword research, and content creation for client websites. I have successfully improved organic visibility and search rankings by implementing SEO best practices. My experience includes building and maintaining WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, and I am proficient with analytics tools such as SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, and Google Search Console. I am also well-versed in technical SEO, including structured data and schema markup, which I have applied on my own project, mirook.com, to enhance visibility in both traditional and AI-driven search engines.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work with content editors, sales, and marketing teams to drive SEO and keep content fresh and optimized. I understand the importance of aligning SEO with broader business goals and am eager to contribute to IKEA's digital strategy. My ability to think creatively and strategically, combined with my problem-solving skills, will enable me to identify and resolve SEO challenges effectively.

I am committed to continuous learning and staying updated on industry shifts, including mobile strategy and the evolving landscape of search. I am also enthusiastic about spreading an SEO mindset across teams and fostering a culture of collaboration.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my background and skills can contribute to IKEA's success. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)
